response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but his profile does not match the core requirements of this role. His C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 plus a thesis project, far short of the mandatory 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development. He has no Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was retail investment fintech, not capital markets systems), and no evident SQL Server/Oracle depth. His recent work is TypeScript/Node.js-centric, making him a poor fit despite solid fundamentals.
strengths: Long, broad software engineering career with low-latency and systems-level experience (DLang, C)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, DevOps tooling, and pairing
Excellent communication skills evidenced by workshops, talks, and open-source leadership
concerns: C++ experience is brief (~7 months professionally, ~10 years ago), not the required 5–10 years on Windows
No Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle expertise; recent stack is TypeScript/Node.js, far from the role's core

key_factors.factor: Missing capital markets / fixed income domain
Strong general engineering fundamentals and communication
